title: Fix recipe premature-outcome detection and abort
description:
## Design Document
@docs/design/recipe-premature-outcome-fix.md

## Overview
Recipe orchestration demands the JSON outcome block on turns that are not the
final one and aborts the recipe on the second miss, and the JSON detector only
scans the last 5 lines. This epic makes the orchestrator tolerant of still-working
turns and reliable at detecting the outcome wherever it appears. Three independent
pieces: (A) broaden find-json-block, (B) forgiving capped retry policy in
process-orchestration-response, (C) harden on-turn-complete so the recipe callback
only fires on a genuine end-of-turn assistant write (root-cause trigger fix).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. find-json-block returns the outcome object when it appears anywhere in the
   response, including beyond the last 5 lines and inside a ```json fence.
2. find-json-block returns nil only when no {...} outcome object exists.
3. A missing outcome no longer aborts the recipe on the second occurrence; the
   recipe exits with "orchestration-error" only after max-outcome-reminders
   (default >= 2) consecutive failures.
4. A valid outcome on any turn clears step-retry-counts for the step and
   transitions normally.
5. should-exit-recipe? guardrails still bound the run (no infinite loop).
6. All pre-existing orchestration_test.clj / orchestration_server_test.clj tests pass.
7. New tests cover the 5-line-window miss, fenced/multi-line JSON, and the capped
   retry policy.
8. on-turn-complete fires the recipe callback only on a genuine end-of-turn
   assistant message, not on intermediate/spurious transcript writes.
notes: Dependency model: blocking is via br parent-child links (children created with --parent), NOT explicit "blocks" edges. "br blocked" correctly shows this epic blocked by 65c.1/.2/.3, and "br ready" shows the three children. Note: "br dep list <epic>" / a "Depends on" section will read empty because there are no explicit blocks edges — that is expected. Do NOT add "br dep add 65c 65c.N": that creates a duplicate edge AND a cycle (parent-child already makes the child depend on the parent), which previously left all children blocked and nothing ready.

title: Broaden find-json-block to detect outcome anywhere in response
description:
## Design Reference
@docs/design/recipe-premature-outcome-fix.md (Detailed Design, Part 1)

## Context
find-json-block scans only the last 5 lines and requires a whole-line {...}, so a
turn that DID emit the outcome is reported "No JSON block found" when the JSON is
not among the final 5 lines (trailing prose/blank lines) or is fenced/multi-line.
This eliminates those false negatives.

## Requirements
- [ ] Scan the entire response (not just the last 5 lines), last-match-wins
- [ ] Accept a ```json fenced block
- [ ] Accept a bare single-line {...} object
- [ ] Return nil only when no {...} outcome object exists

## Technical Approach
- Files to modify: backend/src/voice_code/orchestration.clj (find-json-block)
- Keep the [text] -> string|nil signature; extract-orchestration-outcome still
  validates the parsed object against expected-outcomes, so a stray {...} that is
  not a valid outcome is rejected downstream.
- Dependencies: none (independent)

## Verification
- [ ] Unit: outcome found when it is the last line
- [ ] Unit: outcome found when followed by >4 trailing lines
- [ ] Unit: outcome found inside a ```json fence
- [ ] Unit: last whole-line object wins when multiple {...} present
- [ ] Unit: returns nil when truly absent
- [ ] Regression: existing orchestration_test.clj find-json-block tests pass

## Acceptance Criteria
Epic AC #1, #2 (and contributes to #6, #7).

title: Make process-orchestration-response forgiving with a capped retry policy
description:
## Design Reference
@docs/design/recipe-premature-outcome-fix.md (Detailed Design, Part 2)

## Context
On a missing outcome the driver reminds once (retry-count 0) then aborts the
recipe with "orchestration-error" on the second miss. Two still-working turns thus
kill the run. This replaces remind-once-then-abort with remind up to
max-outcome-reminders, then exit.

## Requirements
- [ ] Compare step retry-count against max-outcome-reminders (default 3) instead
      of the hard-coded 0
- [ ] Read max-outcome-reminders from the recipe map with a default fallback
- [ ] A valid outcome on any turn clears step-retry-counts for that step
- [ ] After the cap, exit with "orchestration-error" as today

## Technical Approach
- Files to modify: backend/src/voice_code/server.clj
  (process-orchestration-response failure branch ~1095-1120); optionally
  backend/src/voice_code/recipes.clj to document the :max-outcome-reminders key.
- Runaway is impossible: should-exit-recipe? still caps max-step-visits /
  max-total-steps, and the per-step reminder counter caps at max-outcome-reminders.
- Dependencies: none (independent; verify together with task C)

## Verification
- [ ] Unit: N consecutive missing-outcome turns return :retry until the cap, then :exit
- [ ] Unit: a valid outcome clears the retry counter and transitions
- [ ] Integration: a step with work-only turns then a final outcome turn completes
- [ ] Regression: orchestration_server_test.clj passes

## Acceptance Criteria
Epic AC #3, #4, #5 (and contributes to #6, #7).
notes: Cross-reference: the three children (65c.1 find-json-block, 65c.2 this task, 65c.3 on-turn-complete) are mutually independent and carry no hard dependency edges. "Verify together with 65c.3" is advisory only — both touch retry/turn handling so co-testing the orchestration_server_test is convenient, not required.

title: Harden on-turn-complete to fire only on genuine end-of-turn assistant write
description:
## Design Reference
@docs/design/recipe-premature-outcome-fix.md (Detailed Design, Component Interactions; Optional enhancement)

## Context
ROOT CAUSE. The recipe callback is fired by on-turn-complete when a filesystem
watcher observes a transcript (JSONL) write. The code notes this can fire on a
spurious/intermediate non-assistant write (server.clj ~1152), capturing assistant
text before the final JSON line. Tightening this stops the premature outcome check
at its source; tasks A and B are detection/safety-net layers on top.

## Requirements
- [ ] Fire the recipe callback only when the triggering write corresponds to a
      genuine end-of-turn assistant message (not an intermediate/tool/non-assistant write)
- [ ] Strengthen the since-uuid guard so a spurious fire is ignored
- [ ] Optionally expose turn metadata (e.g. tool-use?) so a still-working turn can
      be treated as in-progress (the design-doc :wait enhancement)

## Technical Approach
- Files to modify: backend/src/voice_code/server.clj
  (recipe-turn-callbacks / dispatch-recipe-step-via-tmux! / on-turn-complete,
  ~1123-1186). The driver already reads the transcript filtered by :role
  (server.clj:1141), so the final-assistant-message check and tool_use detection
  are reachable.
- Dependencies: none (independent; verify together with task B)

## Verification
- [ ] Unit/Integration: an intermediate non-assistant JSONL write does NOT fire the callback
- [ ] Integration: callback fires once, on the final assistant turn carrying the outcome
- [ ] Regression: orchestration_server_test.clj passes

## Acceptance Criteria
Epic AC #8 (and contributes to #6).
notes: Cross-reference: the three children (65c.1 find-json-block, 65c.2 retry policy, 65c.3 this task) are mutually independent and carry no hard dependency edges. "Verify together with 65c.2" is advisory only — co-testing orchestration_server_test is convenient, not required.

title: Remove obsolete 'bd dolt push' references from AGENTS.md
description: AGENTS.md lines 12 and 71 reference 'bd dolt push', which is dead after the bd->br migration removed Dolt. br auto-exports issues to the git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl; syncing is just a normal 'git add .beads/issues.jsonl' + commit. Remove the 'bd dolt push' lines (replace with the git-add note where it fits the surrounding sync steps). Doc-only. Verify done with: grep -n 'bd dolt' AGENTS.md returns no matches.
